parent_experiment.key_finding: Uniform-shift overlap design produced 0% actual overlap at 25%/50% conditions, making FP=0 at those conditions an artifact

mock_server.description: Flask mock server with Gaussian overlap design, port=18953. Replaces parent's uniform-shift overlap with Gaussian distributions N(mu, sigma=0.05) for both failure and noise. Adds /api/overlap endpoint for per-condition overlap control.

run_experiment.description: Experiment driver: 50-point threshold grid [0.05, ..., 0.54], 5 overlap conditions x 960 samples each, Gaussian overlap via random.gauss(), empirical overlap verification, full cross-condition analysis.

experiment_data.description: Complete raw evidence: per-overlap threshold sweeps (50 thresholds x 5 conditions), calibrated metrics, orthogonality tests, Phase C discrimination probes, empirical overlap measurements

result_draft.description: Code's internal result computation (includes incorrect overall_hypothesis_outcome due to incomplete decision rule implementation)

reproduction_notes: Mock server uses random.gauss() without fixed seed — results are stochastic. Reproduction will yield similar but not identical numerical values.
Gaussian parameters are deterministic: failure N(0.295, 0.05), noise N(mu_noise, 0.05) with mu_noise computed via inverse CDF.
The /api/overlap endpoint sets per-condition noise distribution — must be called before collecting samples for each overlap condition.
Threshold sweep is deterministic given the behavioral scores: 50 thresholds from 0.05 to 0.54 in 0.01 increments.
